dvids.title: U.S. Forces End Operation Inherent Resolve Mission in Iraq
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) completed the orderly departure of U.S. forces and equipment from Erbil Air Base, Sept. 30, marking the end of the Operation Inherent Resolve mission in Iraq.

dvids.title: USS Gonzalez departs Cyprus
dvids.desc: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Gonzalez (DDG 66) completed a scheduled port visit in Limassol, Cyprus, Sept. 29.

dvids.title: Exercise Atlantic Thunder 2026 Concludes in United Kingdom
dvids.desc: Ships, aircraft, and a submarine from the United States and the United Kingdom concluded Exercise Atlantic Thunder 2026, a multi-domain sinking exercise (SINKEX) led by U.S. 6th Fleet, in the North Atlantic, Sept. 25, 2026.
